name: Nexus-Orchestrator
description: Nexus Orchestrator is a self-hosted orchestration layer for local and cloud LLMs. It automatically routes prompts to the best model in your infrastructure using an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Features: Intelligent intent routing - classifies prompts (CODING, REASONING, CREATIVE, VISION, etc.) and dispatches to the right model automatically Hybrid local + cloud orchestration - per-category Local/Cloud provider toggle Vision and document support - attach images and files directly in chat Projects - organize conversations into named sidebar folders Be sure to view README https://github.com/PikkonMG/Unraid-docker-templates/blob/main/docs/Nexus_Unraid_GUIDE.md

paths.name: Config Directory
paths.description: Path to the configuration directory for persistence.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: The port for the Nexus Orchestrator web interface.

variables.name: Admin API Key
variables.description: MANDATORY: Set an API key to protect the orchestrator, admin, and configuration endpoints. All API access is disabled until this is set.

variables.name: Encryption Secret
variables.description: Optional: A separate secret for encrypting stored data. If not set, derives from Admin API Key.

variables.name: Local Provider URL
variables.description: The URL of your local LLM provider. DO NOT use 'localhost' (it refers to the container). Use your server's IP. For Ollama: http:// :11434. For Open WebUI: http:// :8080/api.

variables.name: Local Provider Key
variables.description: The API key for your local LLM provider.

variables.name: Cloud Provider URL
variables.description: The OpenAI-compatible base URL for your cloud provider (e.g. Gemini, OpenRouter, OpenAI).

variables.name: Cloud API Key
variables.description: The API key for your cloud provider (e.g., Gemini or OpenRouter).

variables.name: Router Model
variables.description: The model used to classify prompt intent and route to the right category (e.g. gemma3:4b, gemini-2.0-flash-lite).

variables.name: Router URL
variables.description: Optional: Custom URL for the intent router. Leave blank to use Local Provider URL.

variables.name: Router Key
variables.description: Optional: Custom API key for the intent router endpoint.
